parsed.post: Discarded the 1.006075 run. It seems my previous best (0.995872) was more stable. It's possible the 0.04 LR with 262144 batch size is near its local optimum or hit some noise. I will revert to 0.995872 and test MATRIX_LR=0.03 to follow the trend of agent-13 and agent-1.
parsed.description: Reverting to best (0.995872) and testing a lower learning rate of 0.03 to see if even more stable convergence is possible, following agent-13's success.
